calls.reason: The only later figure is an unverified $6.7B of first-half 2025 R&D, which is broader than training spend. No evidence tests the $6B server-cost counterfactual, so the compound claim can't be called.
This is a broad evaluative judgement. The HBS consulting study and Klarna's projected savings show some value, but neither compares benefits with full costs for the target period.
Audited accounts reported by Ars Technica put OpenAI's 2024 net loss at just over $5B, matching the forecast. OpenAI then raised $6.6B plus a $4B credit line, which fits the stated funding need.
